# Specialist Review Leads

These are unverified advisory leads from independent specialist passes. They are not findings or proof. Verify each relevant claim against the PR/repository evidence before using it in the final review.

## Correctness
````markdown

- [major] open() without a context manager leaks the handle on error. at `src/load.py`:2 (correctness)

- [major] Blocker severity is capped to major for specialists. at `src/load.py`:1 (correctness)
````

## Security
````markdown

- [major] Untrusted path reaches open(); traversal is possible. at `src/load.py`:2 (security)
````

## Tests

- no advisory leads
